title: TidyFactor Skill Manifest — tools section
description: Defines the runtime-executable tools bundled with a TidyFactor skill (scripts/, never tools/ which is packaging/governance-only). Consumed by two independent readers: (a) any agent that needs to resolve a script's absolute path for standalone CLI execution, and (b) tidyfactor-brain's get_skill_manifest + future run_skill_tool dispatcher for deterministic, schema-validated execution. Both readers resolve paths against the SAME anchor, so there is exactly one source of truth for 'where is this script'.

manifest_schema_version.description: Version of this schema itself, independent of the skill's own semver.

skill_id.description: Must match the skill's directory name / SKILL.md id, e.g. 'tidyfactor-design'.

skill_root_anchor.description: Fixed convention, not configurable: skill_root is ALWAYS the directory containing this manifest.json — never the caller's CWD, never the client project directory. This single rule is what eliminates the FileNotFoundError class of failure for every tool listed below, for every consumer.

tools.description: One entry per runtime-executable capability in scripts/. Purely documentary/reference scripts (e.g. one-off migration helpers) should NOT be listed here — only tools a command is meant to invoke.

name.description: Unique id within this skill, e.g. 'audit_design'. When exposed via brain-mcp this becomes the MCP tool name: tidyfactor_{skill_id_short}_{name}.

description.description: One sentence, agent-facing. Shown verbatim in get_skill_manifest output and in the SKILL.md 'Runtime Tool Execution Contract' table (generated from this file, not hand-duplicated).

script.description: Path relative to skill_root, e.g. 'scripts/audit_design.py'. Never a bare filename, never absolute, never relative to CWD.

cli_pattern.description: Template a CLI-only agent fills in directly. Placeholders: {runtime} {skill_root} {script} {target_path} {flags}.

flag.description: CLI flag this arg maps to, e.g. '--fix'.

schema_ref.description: Optional path, relative to skill_root, to a JSON Schema for this tool's output — lets any consumer parse results deterministically regardless of transport.

isolation_recommended.description: true = should run inside tidyfactor-brain's managed environment (heavy/native deps, e.g. image processing). false = safe for any agent to run inline via bash with no extra setup — this is the majority case and must stay dependency-free for external GitHub installs.

dependencies.description: pip/npm package names beyond stdlib. Empty array if none.

invoked_by_commands.description: Command names (from references/commands/*.md) that call this tool. Keeps the SKILL.md contract table auto-derivable instead of a second hand-maintained copy that can drift.
